exposure: Maternal weight status (normal weight, overweight, obesity)
cohort: 132,899 first-time singleton deliveries in Scotland between 2008 and 2015
finding: Women with overweight and obesity in Scotland had significantly increased odds of adverse pregnancy and delivery outcomes, including gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, induction of labor, and emergency caesarean section, compared to women with normal weight.
mod_finding: Women with overweight and obesity had increased odds of requiring labor induction and emergency cesarean section compared to women with normal weight.
